festivals.what: Hua Hin Jazz Festival: held on the beach each year from late May into June, honouring the late King Bhumibol Adulyadej's love of the saxophone and composing. Hua Hin also holds an international kite festival.

Amazing Prachuap Surf and Wind Festival 2026 was held 17 and 18 April 2026 at Pak Nam Pran Buri Beach; the Na Hu Kwang Festival ran 14 and 15 April 2026 at Laem Kum Beach, Thap Sakae District. Dates change each year.

protocol_notes: Hua Hin has been a royal seaside retreat since the 1920s; the Klai Kangwon summer palace, completed in 1929, still serves that role (TAT).
